turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I’d like to make a change to my upcoming flight. I want to switch my return flight from Atlanta to Los Angeles to a nonstop flight from Atlanta to Las Vegas instead. Can you help me with that?

I can help you with your request. To proceed, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for your upcoming flight. If you don’t know your reservation ID, please provide your user ID and I can help locate it for you. Could you please provide your user ID?
Sure, my user ID is james_lee_6136. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my reservation.

Please note that basic economy reservations cannot be modified according to airline policy. If you would like to change your return flight, you would need to cancel this reservation (if eligible) and book a new one.

Would you like to proceed with cancellation, or do you have any other requests?
If it’s possible, I’m willing to upgrade my ticket to economy so I can make the change. Can you check if that’s an option?

Yes, you can upgrade your reservation from basic economy to economy, which will allow you to modify your flights. Would you like to proceed with upgrading your entire reservation to economy class so you can change your return flight from Atlanta to Las Vegas? 

Please confirm if you’d like to proceed with the upgrade, and I’ll guide you through the next steps.
Yes, please go ahead and upgrade my reservation to economy so I can change my return flight. Let me know what I need to do next.

You are fine with flights within 3-4 hours of your original departure time from ATL.

You are willing to pay a fee for the change, up to $100.
